svg.text: ESP32 OBD-II Monitor — full wiring (as installed)
Connect by the pin LABEL printed on each board. Cat6 wires are drawn in their real colours; other wire colours are only for the drawing.
Terminal block (green, 7 screws) — T1 is the RIGHT-most screw
• 12V: fuse box (switched) → 18 AWG → 3A fuse → toggle switch → Cat6 orange pair. Fuse FIRST.
• LM2596 set to 5.0–5.2 V (no load) BEFORE connecting the ESP32.
• Shared strips: 3V3 · GND · D18 (SCK+T_CLK) · D23 (SDI+T_DIN). D19 = T_DO only.
• D19 ↔ D23 short = white screen + fake touches. Display SDO and T_IRQ stay empty.
• Screen glitches: SPI 10 MHz, short SCK/MOSI wires, touch OFF (web Settings → Screen).
• Button noise: 10 kΩ D13→3V3 + 100 nF D13→GND. 4-leg button: diagonal legs.
• Power spikes: 470–1000 µF VIN–GND, 100 µF 3V3–GND near the display.
• OBD pin 16 not used. Check pigtail colours against OBD pins with a meter.
